GetClass.name: GetClass

GetFunctionModule.name: GetFunctionModule
GetFunctionModule.description: Retrieve ABAP function module definition. Supports reading active or inactive version. CAUTION: the default version='active' returns the pre-edit source when an unactivated edit exists — writing on top of it silently destroys the previous edit and no gate catches it. When re-editing, read version='inactive' first (or check GetInactiveObjects), and re-read after every write. A returned 'active' source is NOT proof the FM was ever successfully activated (never-activated FMs also return it).

CheckSyntax.name: CheckSyntax
CheckSyntax.description: [read-only] Run a standalone ABAP syntax check WITHOUT writing anything to SAP. Supports 'class', 'program', 'interface', 'include', and 'function_module'. If source_code is provided (class/program/interface only), the proposed source is compiled in place and checked without touching the server. If source_code is omitted, checks whatever is currently staged as the inactive version on the server (mirroring the post-write check Update* handlers run). Syntax errors are returned as normal results, not as tool errors — only connection/infra failures are reported as errors.

object_type.description: [read-only] ABAP object kind to check: 'class' (CLAS), 'program' (PROG), 'interface' (INTF), 'include' (PROG/I), or 'function_module' (FUGR/FF).

object_name.description: [read-only] Name of the object to check (e.g., ZCL_MY_CLASS).

function_group_name.description: [read-only] Function group name. Required when object_type is 'function_module'.

source_code.description: [read-only] Optional proposed ABAP source code to check in place. Only honored for object_type 'class', 'program', or 'interface' — ignored for 'include' and 'function_module' (see description).

GetSourceDiff.name: GetSourceDiff
GetSourceDiff.description: [read-only] Compute a unified diff between the source code of two ABAP objects (e.g. compare ZCL_A vs ZCL_B, or a program vs a copy of itself). Supports CLAS, PROG, INTF, INCL. If the two sources differ too extensively to safely diff (after trimming common leading/trailing lines), returns { identical: false, too_large: true, reason, stats: { old_lines, new_lines } } instead of a diff.

object_name_a.description: Object name of the first (left / "old") object.

object_type_b.description: Object type of the second (right / "new") object.

object_name_b.description: Object name of the second (right / "new") object.

context_lines.description: Number of unchanged context lines around each change.

CreateInclude.name: CreateInclude

UpdateSourceByPatch.name: UpdateSourceByPatch
UpdateSourceByPatch.description: Modify existing ABAP source code on SAP via a surgical string replacement (find old_string, replace with new_string) instead of resending the full source. Fetches the current source, applies the patch, then delegates the write to the same lock -> syntax-check -> update -> unlock -> (activate) flow used by UpdateClass/UpdateProgram/UpdateInterface/UpdateInclude/UpdateFunctionModule. Supported object_type values: CLAS (class), PROG (program, on-premise/legacy only), INTF (interface), INCL (include, on-premise/legacy only), FUNC (function module, requires function_group). old_string must match the current source exactly, including whitespace, and must be unique unless replace_all is true.

object_type.description: ABAP object kind to patch: CLAS (class), PROG (program), INTF (interface), INCL (include), FUNC (function module).

object_name.description: Name of the object to patch (e.g., ZCL_MY_CLASS).

function_group.description: Function group name. Required when object_type is 'FUNC'.

old_string.description: Exact text to find in the current source (whitespace-sensitive). Must match exactly once unless replace_all is true.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_string instead of requiring a unique match. Default: false.

transport_request.description: Transport request number, passed through to the delegated update handler.

activate.description: Activate the object after the patched source is written. Default: false.

ActivateObjects.name: ActivateObjects
ActivateObjects.description: [high-level] Activate a set of ABAP objects in a single call. Uses the ADT mass-activation endpoint (/sap/bc/adt/activation/runs) so cyclic references between siblings (e.g. main program + multiple cross-referencing includes) resolve in one compilation scope. Returns per-object status, errors, warnings. Falls back to /sap/bc/adt/activation on legacy systems. FUGR recipe: activating function modules alone fails with 'FUNCTION ... cannot be used outside a FUNCTION-POOL' — pass the whole family in ONE run: the function group (type FUGR), its TOP include (FUGR/I with parent_name), every function module (FUGR/FF with parent_name), and the SAPL<group> main program (PROG/P) when present. Do NOT include the system include L<group>UXX. Never mix unrelated objects into the same activation run — activate only the object family being worked. The returned success/activated flags mirror the activation-run response and are NOT proof of activation on their own — confirm by re-querying GetInactiveObjects (your objects absent from the list = actually activated).

type.description: ADT object type code, e.g. 'PROG/P' (program), 'PROG/I' (include), 'CLAS/OC' (class), 'FUGR/FF' (function module).

uri.description: Explicit ADT URI. When provided, overrides name-based URI resolution.

parent_name.description: Parent name — required for FUGR/FF (function group) and FUGR/I (function-group include).

objects.description: Objects to activate in one batch. Supply either explicit uri, or name+type (and parent_name for FUGR/FF, FUGR/I).

preaudit.description: Request pre-audit before activation. Default true.

run_timeout_ms.description: Max time to wait for the activation run to finish (runs endpoint only). Default 120000.

GetSqlQuery.name: GetSqlQuery

Empty cells (including self-closing XML cells) are preserved as null in row order. Complex statements (e.g. 4-way joins, long IN lists) can fail with HTTP 400 — shorten table aliases or replace a long IN list with a BETWEEN range; a sporadic 400 (e.g. under concurrent calls) is retried once automatically. CreateProgram.name: CreateProgram
CreateProgram.description: Create a new ABAP program (report) in SAP system. Creates the program object in initial state. Use UpdateProgram to set source code afterwards.

program_name.description: Program name (e.g., Z_TEST_PROGRAM_001). Must follow SAP naming conventions (start with Z or Y).

description.description: Program description. If not provided, program_name will be used.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LAB, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

program_type.description: Program type: 'executable' (Report) or 'module_pool'. Both are created in the ADT programs/programs collection (PROG/P). Default: 'executable'. To create an include, function group, class pool, or interface pool use the dedicated tool (CreateInclude / CreateFunctionGroup / CreateClass / CreateInterface) — CreateProgram cannot create those object types.

application.description: Application area (e.g., 'S' for System, 'M' for Materials Management). Default: '*'

CreateScreen.name: CreateScreen
CreateScreen.description: Create a new ABAP Screen (Dynpro) on an existing program. Optionally activates.

description.description: Screen description.

dynpro_data.description: Full screen definition as JSON. If omitted, creates minimal screen.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate.description: Activate after creation. Default: false.

CreateServiceBinding.name: CreateServiceBinding
CreateServiceBinding.description: Create ABAP service binding via ADT Business Services endpoint. XML is generated from high-level parameters.

package_name.description: ABAP package name.

description.description: Optional description. Defaults to service_binding_name when omitted.

service_binding_version.description: Service binding ADT version. Default inferred from type.

service_name.description: Published service name. Default: service_binding_name if omitted.

transport_request.description: Optional transport request for transport checks.

activate.description: Activate service binding after create. Default: true.

CreateServiceDefinition.name: CreateServiceDefinition
CreateServiceDefinition.description: Create a new ABAP service definition for OData services. Service definitions define the structure and behavior of OData services. Uses stateful session for proper lock management.

service_definition_name.description: Service definition name (e.g., ZSD_MY_SERVICE). Must follow SAP naming conventions (start with Z or Y).

description.description: Service definition description. If not provided, service_definition_name will be used.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

source_code.description: Service definition source code (optional). If not provided, a minimal template will be created.

activate.description: Activate service definition after creation. Default: true.

CreateStructure.name: CreateStructure
CreateStructure.description: Create a new ABAP structure in SAP system with fields and type references. Includes create, activate, and verify steps. The fields/includes input is generated into DDIC "define structure" DDL and applied under lock; creation fails explicitly (before any object is created) when a field spec is incomplete — e.g. a built-in type missing its length, or a field with neither data_element nor data_type.

structure_name.description: Structure name (e.g., ZZ_S_TEST_001). Must follow SAP naming conventions.

description.description: Structure description. If not provided, structure_name will be used.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

data_type.description: Data type: CHAR, NUMC, DATS, TIMS, DEC, INT1, INT2, INT4, INT8, CURR, QUAN, etc.

decimals.description: Decimal places (for DEC, CURR, QUAN types)

data_element.description: Data element name for type reference (optional)

description.description: Field description

currency_reference.description: For CURR fields: name of the CUKY field in THIS structure that carries the currency key. Emits @Semantics.amount.currencyCode (optional).

unit_reference.description: For QUAN fields: name of the UNIT field in THIS structure that carries the unit of measure. Emits @Semantics.quantity.unitOfMeasure (optional).

includes.description: Include other structures in this structure

activate.description: Activate structure after creation. Default: true. Set to false for batch operations (activate multiple objects later).

CreateTable.name: CreateTable
CreateTable.description: Create a new ABAP table via the ADT API. Creates the table object in initial state. Use UpdateTable to set DDL code afterwards.

table_name.description: Table name (e.g., ZZ_TEST_TABLE_001). Must follow SAP naming conventions.

description.description: Table description for validation and creation.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

CreateTextElement.name: CreateTextElement
CreateTextElement.description: Add a text element (text symbol, selection text, program title, or list heading) to an ABAP program. Optionally activates after write.

key.description: Row key. For "I" use 3-char code (e.g., "001"). For "S" use the parameter/select-option name. For "R" the key is ignored (single row).

language.description: Language key (1-char). Defaults to SAP logon language.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate.description: Activate the parent program after write. Default: false.

CreateTransport.name: CreateTransport
CreateTransport.description: Create a new ABAP transport request in SAP system for development objects.

description.description: Transport request description (mandatory)

target_system.description: Target system for transport (optional, e.g., 'PRD', 'QAS'). If not provided or empty, uses 'LOCAL'

owner.description: Transport owner (optional, defaults to current user)

CreateUnitTest.name: CreateUnitTest
CreateUnitTest.description: Start an ABAP Unit test run for provided class test definitions. Returns run_id for status/result queries.

container_class.description: Class that owns the test include (e.g., ZCL_MAIN_CLASS).

test_class.description: Test class name inside the include (e.g., LTCL_MAIN_CLASS).

tests.description: List of container/test class pairs to execute.

title.description: Optional title for the ABAP Unit run.

context.description: Optional context string shown in SAP tools.

CreateView.name: CreateView
CreateView.description: Create CDS View or Classic View in SAP. Creates the view object in initial state. Use UpdateView to set DDL source code afterwards.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LAB, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (required for transportable packages).

description.description: Optional description (defaults to view_name).

DeleteBehaviorDefinition.name: DeleteBehaviorDefinition
DeleteBehaviorDefinition.description: Delete an ABAP behavior definition from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteBehaviorImplementation.name: DeleteBehaviorImplementation
DeleteBehaviorImplementation.description: Delete an ABAP behavior implementation from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteCdsUnitTest.name: DeleteCdsUnitTest
DeleteCdsUnitTest.description: Delete a CDS unit test class (global class).

transport_request.description: Transport request number (required for transportable packages).

DeleteClass.name: DeleteClass
DeleteClass.description: Delete an ABAP class from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteDataElement.name: DeleteDataElement
DeleteDataElement.description: Delete an ABAP data element from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteDomain.name: DeleteDomain
DeleteDomain.description: Delete an ABAP domain from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteFunctionGroup.name: DeleteFunctionGroup
DeleteFunctionGroup.description: Delete an ABAP function group from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteFunctionModule.name: DeleteFunctionModule
DeleteFunctionModule.description: Delete an ABAP function module from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

function_group_name.description: FunctionGroup name containing the function module (e.g., Z_MY_FUNCTIONGROUP).

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteGuiStatus.name: DeleteGuiStatus
DeleteGuiStatus.description: Delete an ABAP GUI Status from a program. Handles lock/unlock automatically.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

DeleteInclude.name: DeleteInclude
DeleteInclude.description: Delete an existing ABAP Include program (Type I) from the SAP system via ADT API. If the include is referenced by a main program, provide main_program so the handler can first remove the `INCLUDE <name>.` line from the main program source before deleting.

main_program.description: Optional. Name of the main program referencing this include. If provided, the `INCLUDE <name>.` line is removed from the main program source first (so the include is no longer referenced and delete succeeds).

transport_request.description: Transport request number. Required for transportable packages. Optional for local ($TMP) objects. Also used for updating the main program if main_program is provided.

remove_from_main.description: Auto-remove `INCLUDE <name>.` line from main program source. Default: true when main_program is provided. Set false to skip the main-program modification.

DeleteInterface.name: DeleteInterface
DeleteInterface.description: Delete an ABAP interface from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteLocalDefinitions.name: DeleteLocalDefinitions
DeleteLocalDefinitions.description: Delete local definitions from an ABAP class by clearing the definitions include. Manages lock, update, unlock, and optional activation.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate_on_delete.description: Activate parent class after deleting. Default: false

DeleteLocalMacros.name: DeleteLocalMacros
DeleteLocalMacros.description: Delete local macros from an ABAP class by clearing the macros include. Manages lock, update, unlock, and optional activation. Note: Macros are supported in older ABAP versions but not in newer ones.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate_on_delete.description: Activate parent class after deleting. Default: false

DeleteLocalTestClass.name: DeleteLocalTestClass
DeleteLocalTestClass.description: Delete a local test class from an ABAP class by clearing the testclasses include. Manages lock, update, unlock, and optional activation of parent class.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (required for transportable objects).

activate_on_delete.description: Activate parent class after deleting test class. Default: false

DeleteLocalTypes.name: DeleteLocalTypes
DeleteLocalTypes.description: Delete local types from an ABAP class by clearing the implementations include. Manages lock, update, unlock, and optional activation.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate_on_delete.description: Activate parent class after deleting. Default: false

DeleteMetadataExtension.name: DeleteMetadataExtension
DeleteMetadataExtension.description: Delete an ABAP metadata extension from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteProgram.name: DeleteProgram
DeleteProgram.description: Delete an ABAP program from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteScreen.name: DeleteScreen
DeleteScreen.description: Delete an ABAP Screen (Dynpro) from a program. Handles lock/unlock automatically.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

DeleteServiceBinding.name: DeleteServiceBinding
DeleteServiceBinding.description: Delete ABAP service binding via ADT Business Services endpoint.

transport_request.description: Optional transport request for deletion transport flow.

DeleteServiceDefinition.name: DeleteServiceDefinition
DeleteServiceDefinition.description: Delete an ABAP service definition from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteStructure.name: DeleteStructure
DeleteStructure.description: Delete an ABAP structure from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteTable.name: DeleteTable
DeleteTable.description: Delete an ABAP table from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DeleteTextElement.name: DeleteTextElement
DeleteTextElement.description: Delete a text element from an ABAP program text pool. key="*" wipes all rows of the given text_type; text_type="*" wipes the whole pool.

text_type.description: "I"|"S"|"R"|"H", or "*" to wipe every row in the language.

key.description: Row key, or "*" to delete every row of the given text_type.

language.description: Language key. Defaults to SAP logon language.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate.description: Activate the parent program after write. Default: false.

DeleteUnitTest.name: DeleteUnitTest
DeleteUnitTest.description: Delete an ABAP Unit test run. Note: ADT does not support deleting unit test runs and will return an error.

DeleteView.name: DeleteView
DeleteView.description: Delete an ABAP view from the SAP system. Includes deletion check before actual deletion. Transport request optional for $TMP objects.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable objects. Optional for local objects ($TMP).

DescribeByList.name: DescribeByList
DescribeByList.description: [read-only] Batch description for a list of ABAP objects. Input: objects: Array<{ name: string, type?: string }>. Each object may be of type: PROG/P, FUGR, PROG/I, CLAS/OC, FUGR/FC, INTF/OI, TABLE, STRUCTURE, etc.

name.description: [read-only] Object name (required, must be valid ABAP object name or mask)

GetAbapAST.name: GetAbapAST
GetAbapAST.description: [read-only] Parse ABAP code and return AST (Abstract Syntax Tree) in JSON format.

filePath.description: Optional file path to write the result to

GetAbapSemanticAnalysis.name: GetAbapSemanticAnalysis
GetAbapSemanticAnalysis.description: [read-only] Perform semantic analysis on ABAP code and return symbols, types, scopes, and dependencies.

filePath.description: Optional file path to write the result to

GetAbapSystemSymbols.name: GetAbapSystemSymbols
GetAbapSystemSymbols.description: [read-only] Resolve ABAP symbols from semantic analysis with SAP system information including types, scopes, descriptions, and packages.

code.description: ABAP source code to analyze and resolve symbols for

filePath.description: Optional file path to write the result to

GetAdtTypes.name: GetAdtTypes
GetAdtTypes.description: [read-only] Retrieve all valid ADT object types (CLAS, TABL, PROG, DEVC, FUGR, INTF, DDLS, DTEL, DOMA, SRVD, SRVB, BDEF, DDLX, etc.) or validate a specific type name.

GetAtcFindings.name: GetAtcFindings
GetAtcFindings.description: [read-only] Run ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC) static checks on an object or package and return findings (priority 1=error/2=warning/3+=info, check title, message, object, location). Does not modify or execute repository objects.

object_uri.description: Explicit ADT URI of the target (e.g. /sap/bc/adt/oo/classes/zcl_x). If given, object_name/object_type are ignored.

object_name.description: Object name (used with object_type when object_uri is absent).

object_type.description: SAP object type code for URI resolution: CLAS, INTF, PROG, FUGR, TABL, STRU, VIEW, DTEL, DOMA, DDLS, BDEF, SRVD, SRVB, DEVC (package).

check_variant.description: ATC check variant name. If omitted, the system default variant is resolved from /atc/customizing.

GetBadiImplementations.name: GetBadiImplementations
GetBadiImplementations.description: [read-only] Find implementations of a (classic) BAdI definition. Use during symptom analysis when a standard SAP BAdI is implicated — answers 'which Z class extends this standard BAdI?'. Example flow: PO BAPI error → ME_PROCESS_PO_CUST → list Z impls → read the impl class source via GetClass to find the bug. Currently ECC-only (routes through the ZMCP_ADT_DDIC_BADI bridge FM). Classic BAdI only; kernel BAdI returns kind='unknown'.

badi_definition.description: BAdI definition name (e.g., ME_PROCESS_PO_CUST). Will be uppercased.

customer_only.description: Restrict to Z*/Y* implementations. Default: true. Set false to include SAP-shipped implementations.

active_only.description: Restrict to active implementations only. Default: true.

include_methods.description: Include the list of redefined method names per implementation (from SXC_EXIT). Default: true.

GetBehaviorDefinition.name: GetBehaviorDefinition
GetBehaviorDefinition.description: Retrieve ABAP behavior definition definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetBehaviorImplementation.name: GetBehaviorImplementation
GetBehaviorImplementation.description: Retrieve ABAP behavior implementation definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetCallGraph.name: GetCallGraph
GetCallGraph.description: [read-only] Build a call-relationship graph (callers and/or callees) for an ABAP object via server-side breadth-first traversal — replaces repeated round-trips of GetWhereUsed by expanding discovered nodes automatically up to a bounded depth and node count. Static analysis only: dynamic calls, BAdI dispatch, and other runtime-only wiring are not captured.

function_group.description: Function group name — required only when object_type is FUNC (function modules are addressed as GROUP|NAME).

direction.description: 'callers' = who uses the root (default), 'callees' = what the root calls, 'both' = both traversals merged into one graph.

depth.description: Max BFS depth from the root (1-4). Default 2.

max_nodes.description: Global cap on total nodes in the returned graph (max 300). Default 100.

custom_only.description: When true (default), only Z*/Y*//NAMESPACE/ custom objects are expanded further during traversal — standard SAP objects still appear as leaf nodes but are not traversed past. The root is always expanded regardless of this flag.

GetCdsUnitTest.name: GetCdsUnitTest
GetCdsUnitTest.description: Retrieve CDS unit test run status and result for a previously started run_id.

run_id.description: Run identifier returned by unit test run.

GetCdsUnitTestResult.name: GetCdsUnitTestResult
GetCdsUnitTestResult.description: Retrieve CDS unit test run result for a run_id.

run_id.description: Run identifier returned by unit test run.

with_navigation_uris.description: Include navigation URIs in result if supported.

GetCdsUnitTestStatus.name: GetCdsUnitTestStatus
GetCdsUnitTestStatus.description: Retrieve CDS unit test run status for a run_id.

run_id.description: Run identifier returned by unit test run.

with_long_polling.description: Enable long polling while waiting for status.

GetClass.name: GetClass
GetClass.description: Retrieve ABAP class source code. Supports reading active or inactive version. Optionally append a compressed dependency context (public signatures of referenced classes/interfaces) via with_context.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

with_context.description: If true, append a "dependency_context" field with compressed public contracts (signatures) of every class/interface referenced by this class, so callers get surrounding context in one call. Function modules referenced via CALL FUNCTION are noted but not resolved. Default false.

context_max_deps.description: Max number of dependencies to resolve when with_context is true (1-15). Default 10.

GetClassMethod.name: GetClassMethod
GetClassMethod.description: [read-only] Read the source of a single method implementation (the METHOD...ENDMETHOD block) from an ABAP class, without fetching the entire class source. Use this instead of GetClass/ReadClass when only one method needs inspecting — dramatically smaller than reading the whole class.

method_name.description: Method name to extract (e.g. 'GET_DATA', or for interface method implementations 'ZIF_FOO~BAR').

GetDataElement.name: GetDataElement
GetDataElement.description: Retrieve ABAP data element definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetDomain.name: GetDomain
GetDomain.description: Retrieve ABAP domain definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetEnhancementImpl.name: GetEnhancementImpl
GetEnhancementImpl.description: [read-only] Retrieve source code of a specific enhancement implementation by its name and enhancement spot.

GetEnhancementSpot.name: GetEnhancementSpot
GetEnhancementSpot.description: [read-only] Retrieve metadata and list of implementations for a specific enhancement spot.

GetEnhancements.name: GetEnhancements
GetEnhancements.description: [read-only] Retrieve a list of enhancements for a given ABAP object.

GetFunctionGroup.name: GetFunctionGroup
GetFunctionGroup.description: Retrieve ABAP function group definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetFunctionModule.name: GetFunctionModule
GetFunctionModule.description: Retrieve ABAP function module definition. Supports reading active or inactive version. CAUTION: the default version='active' returns the pre-edit source when an unactivated edit exists — writing on top of it silently destroys the previous edit and no gate catches it. When re-editing, read version='inactive' first (or check GetInactiveObjects), and re-read after every write. A returned 'active' source is NOT proof the FM was ever successfully activated (never-activated FMs also return it).

function_group_name.description: FunctionGroup name containing the function module (e.g., Z_MY_FUNCTIONGROUP).

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

check_inactive.description: When reading the active version, also read the inactive version (one extra ADT call) and, if an unactivated version exists and its source differs, attach a 'warning' to the response. Default true. The extra read never fails or slows the main read. Set false to skip it.

GetGuiStatus.name: GetGuiStatus
GetGuiStatus.description: Get ABAP GUI Status definition including statuses, function codes, menus, toolbars, and titles.

status_name.description: Optional: filter to a specific GUI Status name. If omitted, returns all statuses.

GetGuiStatusList.name: GetGuiStatusList
GetGuiStatusList.description: [read-only] List all GUI statuses belonging to an ABAP program.

GetInactiveObjects.name: GetInactiveObjects
GetInactiveObjects.description: [read-only] Get a list of inactive ABAP objects — modified but not yet activated, pending activation. Shows classes, tables, CDS views, and other objects awaiting activation.

GetInclude.name: GetInclude
GetInclude.description: [read-only] Retrieve source code of a specific ABAP include file.

GetIncludesList.name: GetIncludesList
GetIncludesList.description: [read-only] Recursively discover and list ALL include files within an ABAP program or include.

object_name.description: Name of the ABAP program or include

object_type.description: [read-only] ADT object type (e.g. PROG/P, PROG/I, FUGR, CLAS/OC)

detailed.description: [read-only] If true, returns structured JSON with metadata and raw XML.

timeout.description: [read-only] Timeout in ms for each ADT request.

GetInstalledComponents.name: GetInstalledComponents
GetInstalledComponents.description: [read-only] Retrieve installed software components with release/support-package level (e.g. SAP_BASIS 757 SP02). Returns { supported: false } instead of an error when the underlying ADT endpoint is absent on this release.

GetInterface.name: GetInterface
GetInterface.description: Retrieve ABAP interface definition. Supports reading active or inactive version. Optionally append a compressed dependency context (public signatures of referenced classes/interfaces) via with_context.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

with_context.description: If true, append a "dependency_context" field with compressed public contracts (signatures) of every class/interface referenced by this interface, so callers get surrounding context in one call. Function modules referenced via CALL FUNCTION are noted but not resolved. Default false.

context_max_deps.description: Max number of dependencies to resolve when with_context is true (1-15). Default 10.

GetLocalDefinitions.name: GetLocalDefinitions
GetLocalDefinitions.description: Retrieve local definitions source code from a class (definitions include). Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetLocalMacros.name: GetLocalMacros
GetLocalMacros.description: Retrieve local macros source code from a class (macros include). Supports reading active or inactive version. Note: Macros are supported in older ABAP versions but not in newer ones.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetLocalTestClass.name: GetLocalTestClass
GetLocalTestClass.description: Retrieve local test class source code from a class. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetLocalTypes.name: GetLocalTypes
GetLocalTypes.description: Retrieve local types source code from a class (implementations include). Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetMetadataExtension.name: GetMetadataExtension
GetMetadataExtension.description: Retrieve ABAP metadata extension definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetNodeStructureLow.name: GetNodeStructureLow
GetNodeStructureLow.description: [low-level] Fetch node structure from ADT repository. Used for object tree navigation and structure discovery. Can use session_id and session_state from GetSession to maintain the same session.

node_id.description: Optional node ID (default: "0000" for root). Use to fetch child nodes.

session_id.description: Session ID from GetSession. If not provided, a new session will be created.

session_state.description: Session state from GetSession (cookies, csrf_token, cookie_store). Required if session_id is provided.

GetObjectInfo.name: GetObjectInfo
GetObjectInfo.description: [read-only] Return ABAP object tree structure for packages (DEVC), classes (CLAS), programs (PROG), function groups (FUGR), and other objects. Shows root, group nodes, and terminal leaves up to maxDepth. Enrich each node with description and package via SearchObject if enrich=true.

parent_type.description: [read-only] Parent object type (e.g. DEVC/K, CLAS/OC, PROG/P)

maxDepth.description: [read-only] Maximum tree depth (default depends on type)

enrich.description: [read-only] Whether to add description and package via SearchObject (default true)

GetObjectNodeFromCache.name: GetObjectNodeFromCache
GetObjectNodeFromCache.description: [read-only] Returns a node from the in-memory objects list cache by OBJECT_TYPE, OBJECT_NAME, TECH_NAME, and expands OBJECT_URI if present.

GetObjectStructure.name: GetObjectStructure
GetObjectStructure.description: [read-only] Retrieve ADT object structure as a compact JSON tree.

GetObjectStructureLow.name: GetObjectStructureLow
GetObjectStructureLow.description: [low-level] Retrieve ADT object structure as compact JSON tree. Returns XML response with object structure tree. Can use session_id and session_state from GetSession to maintain the same session.

session_id.description: Session ID from GetSession. If not provided, a new session will be created.

session_state.description: Session state from GetSession (cookies, csrf_token, cookie_store). Required if session_id is provided.

GetObjectsByType.name: GetObjectsByType
GetObjectsByType.description: [read-only] Retrieves all ABAP objects of a specific type (classes, tables, programs, interfaces, etc.) under a given parent node. Useful for listing all objects of one type within a package or composite object.

GetObjectsList.name: GetObjectsList
GetObjectsList.description: [read-only] Recursively retrieves all child ABAP repository objects for a given parent — programs (PROG), function groups (FUGR), classes (CLAS), packages (DEVC), and other composite objects — including nested includes and subcomponents.

GetPackage.name: GetPackage
GetPackage.description: Retrieve ABAP package metadata (description, super-package, etc.). Supports reading active or inactive version.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., Z_MY_PACKAGE).

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetPackageContents.name: GetPackageContents
GetPackageContents.description: [read-only] Retrieve objects inside an ABAP package as a flat list. Supports recursive traversal of subpackages.

package_name.description: Name of the ABAP package (e.g., "ZMY_PACKAGE")

include_subpackages.description: Include contents of subpackages recursively (default: false)

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for recursive package traversal (default: 5)

include_descriptions.description: Include object descriptions in response (default: true)

GetPackageTree.name: GetPackageTree
GetPackageTree.description: [high-level] Retrieve complete package tree structure including subpackages and objects. Returns hierarchical tree with object names, types, and descriptions.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., "ZMY_PACKAGE")

include_subpackages.description: Include subpackages recursively in the tree. If false, subpackages are shown as first-level objects but not recursively expanded. Default: true

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for recursive package traversal. Default: 5

include_descriptions.description: Include object descriptions in response. Default: true

debug.description: Include diagnostic metadata in response (counts, types, hierarchy info). Default: false

GetProgFullCode.name: GetProgFullCode
GetProgFullCode.description: [read-only] Returns the full code for a program or function group, including all includes, in tree traversal order.

name.description: [read-only] Technical name of the program or function group (e.g., '/CBY/MM_INVENTORY')

type.description: [read-only] 'PROG/P' for program or 'FUGR' for function group

GetProgram.name: GetProgram
GetProgram.description: Retrieve ABAP program definition. Supports reading active or inactive version. Optionally append a compressed dependency context (public signatures of referenced classes/interfaces) via with_context.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

with_context.description: If true, append a "dependency_context" field with compressed public contracts (signatures) of every class/interface referenced by this program, so callers get surrounding context in one call. Function modules referenced via CALL FUNCTION are noted but not resolved. Default false.

context_max_deps.description: Max number of dependencies to resolve when with_context is true (1-15). Default 10.

GetScreen.name: GetScreen
GetScreen.description: Get ABAP Screen (Dynpro) definition including metadata, fields, and flow logic source code.

GetScreensList.name: GetScreensList
GetScreensList.description: [read-only] List all screens (dynpros) belonging to an ABAP program.

GetServiceBinding.name: GetServiceBinding
GetServiceBinding.description: Retrieve ABAP service binding source/metadata by name via ADT Business Services endpoint.

service_binding_name.description: Service binding name (for example: ZUI_MY_BINDING). Case-insensitive.

response_format.description: Preferred response format. "json" requests JSON from endpoint, "xml" parses XML payload, "plain" returns raw text.

GetServiceDefinition.name: GetServiceDefinition
GetServiceDefinition.description: Retrieve ABAP service definition definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetSession.name: GetSession
GetSession.description: [read-only] Get a new session ID and current session state (cookies, CSRF token) for reuse across multiple ADT operations. Use this to maintain the same session and lock handle across multiple requests.

force_new.description: Force creation of a new session even if one exists. Default: false

GetSourceDiff.name: GetSourceDiff
GetSourceDiff.description: [read-only] Compute a unified diff between the source code of two ABAP objects (e.g. compare ZCL_A vs ZCL_B, or a program vs a copy of itself). Supports CLAS, PROG, INTF, INCL. If the two sources differ too extensively to safely diff (after trimming common leading/trailing lines), returns { identical: false, too_large: true, reason, stats: { old_lines, new_lines } } instead of a diff.

object_type_a.description: Object type of the first (left / "old") object.

object_name_a.description: Object name of the first (left / "old") object.

object_type_b.description: Object type of the second (right / "new") object.

object_name_b.description: Object name of the second (right / "new") object.

context_lines.description: Number of unchanged context lines around each change.

GetSqlQuery.name: GetSqlQuery
GetSqlQuery.description: [read-only] Execute ABAP SQL SELECT queries on database tables and CDS views via SAP ADT Data Preview API. Use for ad-hoc data retrieval, row counts, and filtered queries. Empty cells (including self-closing XML cells) are preserved as null in row order. Complex statements (e.g. 4-way joins, long IN lists) can fail with HTTP 400 — shorten table aliases or replace a long IN list with a BETWEEN range; a sporadic 400 (e.g. under concurrent calls) is retried once automatically. The response also reports returned_row_count (rows actually parsed), truncated (true when the row_number cap was hit or the server total exceeds it), and server_total_rows (server-reported total when the XML provides it).

row_number.description: [read-only] Maximum number of rows to return

acknowledge_risk.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has explicitly authorized row extraction from an 'ask'-tier protected table. The approval is logged to stderr for audit. Has no effect on 'deny'-tier tables.

GetStructure.name: GetStructure
GetStructure.description: Retrieve ABAP structure definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetSystemInfo.name: GetSystemInfo
GetSystemInfo.description: [read-only] Retrieve SAP system identity: system ID (SID), client, logon language, connected user, and an ADT-stack "modern vs legacy" hint. Returns { supported: false } instead of an error when the underlying ADT endpoints are absent on this release.

GetTable.name: GetTable
GetTable.description: Retrieve ABAP table definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetTableContents.name: GetTableContents
GetTableContents.description: [read-only] Retrieve contents (data preview) of an ABAP database table or CDS view. Returns rows of data like SE16/SE16N.

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to retrieve

acknowledge_risk.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has explicitly authorized row extraction from an 'ask'-tier protected table. The approval is logged to stderr for audit. Has no effect on 'deny'-tier tables.

GetTextElement.name: GetTextElement
GetTextElement.description: Read ABAP program text pool (text symbols, selection texts, title, headings). Optionally filter by text_type / key.

language.description: Language key (1-char, e.g., "E", "D", "K"). Defaults to the SAP logon language.

text_type.description: Filter by ID: "I"=text symbol, "S"=selection text, "R"=program title, "H"=list heading.

key.description: Optional: filter by row key (e.g., "001" for text symbol TEXT-001, or a parameter name for selection text).

GetTransaction.name: GetTransaction
GetTransaction.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP transaction (t-code) details — program, screen, authorization object, and transaction type (dialog, report, OO).

GetTransport.name: GetTransport
GetTransport.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP transport request information including metadata, included objects, and status from SAP system.

owner.description: SAP user who owns the transport. On ECC the session-user-scoped path endpoint silently filters out other users' TRs — pass `owner` to retry via the list endpoint. On S/4 usually unnecessary, but provide it if the path read is rejected by authorization.

include_objects.description: Include list of objects in transport (default: true)

include_tasks.description: Include list of tasks in transport (default: true)

GetTypeInfo.name: GetTypeInfo
GetTypeInfo.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP type information for domains (DOMA), data elements (DTEL), table types, and structures. Returns field definitions, value ranges, fixed values, and DDIC metadata.

include_structure_fallback.description: When true (default), tries DDIC structure lookup only if type lookup returns 404/empty.

GetUnitTest.name: GetUnitTest
GetUnitTest.description: Retrieve ABAP Unit test run status and result for a previously started run_id.

GetUnitTestResult.name: GetUnitTestResult
GetUnitTestResult.description: Retrieve ABAP Unit test run result for a run_id.

run_id.description: Run identifier returned by unit test run.

with_navigation_uris.description: Include navigation URIs in result if supported.

GetUnitTestStatus.name: GetUnitTestStatus
GetUnitTestStatus.description: Retrieve ABAP Unit test run status for a run_id.

run_id.description: Run identifier returned by unit test run.

with_long_polling.description: Enable long polling while waiting for status.

GetView.name: GetView
GetView.description: Retrieve ABAP view definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

version.description: Version to read: "active" (default) for deployed version, "inactive" for modified but not activated version.

GetVirtualFoldersLow.name: GetVirtualFoldersLow
GetVirtualFoldersLow.description: [low-level] Retrieve hierarchical virtual folder contents from ADT information system. Used for browsing ABAP objects by package, group, type, etc.

preselection.description: Optional preselection filters (facet-value pairs for filtering)

values.description: Array of facet values to filter by

facet_order.description: Order of facets in response (e.g., ["package", "group", "type"]). Default: ["package", "group", "type"]

GetWhereUsed.name: GetWhereUsed
GetWhereUsed.description: [read-only] Find where-used references (cross-references, usages, dependencies) for ABAP objects — classes, interfaces, tables, data elements, programs, function modules, etc. Returns list of all referencing objects with their types and packages.

object_type.description: Type of the ABAP object (class, interface, program, table, etc.)

enable_all_types.description: If true, searches in all available object types (Eclipse 'select all' behavior). Default: false (uses SAP default scope)

GrepObjects.name: GrepObjects
GrepObjects.description: [read-only] Search ABAP source code for a regex pattern across multiple named objects in a single call — finds matching lines (with optional context) instead of reading each object one by one. Supports CLAS, PROG, INTF, INCL, and FUGR (function group). Individual function modules (FUNC) are not supported; use FUGR with the group name to search the whole group.

object_type.description: ABAP object type: CLAS, PROG, INTF, INCL, or FUGR.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression source to search for (e.g. "SELECT\\s+\\*").

context_lines.description: Number of lines of context before/after each match (0-5). Default: 0.

max_results.description: Maximum total matches to return across all objects. Default: 100.

GrepPackages.name: GrepPackages
GrepPackages.description: [read-only] Search ABAP source code for a regex pattern across every object in one or more packages, in a single call — finds matching lines (with optional context) instead of listing then reading objects one by one. Scans CLAS, PROG, INTF, INCL, and FUGR (function group) objects; other repository object types (tables, data elements, domains, etc.) are skipped since they carry no source text. Optionally recurses into subpackages and can filter to specific object types (e.g. ['CLAS','PROG']).

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression source to search for (e.g. "SELECT\\s+\\*").

context_lines.description: Number of lines of context before/after each match (0-5). Default: 0.

max_results.description: Maximum total matches to return across all objects. Once reached, remaining objects are not fetched. Default: 200.

object_types.description: Optional filter to only scan these object types (e.g. ['CLAS','PROG']). Allowed: CLAS, PROG, INTF, INCL, FUGR. If omitted, all source-bearing types are scanned.

ListServiceBindingTypes.name: ListServiceBindingTypes
ListServiceBindingTypes.description: List available service binding types (for example ODataV2/ODataV4) from ADT Business Services endpoint.

ListTransports.name: ListTransports
ListTransports.description: [read-only] List transport requests for the current or specified user. Returns modifiable and/or released workbench and customizing requests.

user.description: SAP user name. If not provided, returns transports for the current user.

modifiable_only.description: Only return modifiable (not yet released) transports. Default: true.

PatchGuiStatus.name: PatchGuiStatus
PatchGuiStatus.description:
Row-level merge into an existing ABAP GUI Status definition. Fetches current CUA → merges the caller-supplied changes (by natural key) → writes merged result back. Rows / fields you omit are preserved. Safer default for targeted edits; use UpdateGuiStatus only when you truly want to replace the whole CUA.

Merge keys per table:
  STA=CODE, FUN=CODE, PFK=CODE+PFNO, BUT=PFK_CODE+CODE+NO, TIT=CODE,
  MEN=CODE+NO, MTX=CODE, ACT=CODE+NO, SET=STATUS+FUNCTION,
  DOC=OBJ_TYPE+OBJ_CODE, BIV=CODE+POS.

changes.description: Partial CUA data to merge into the current definition. Same shape as cua_data (ADM / STA / FUN / MEN / MTX / ACT / BUT / PFK / SET / DOC / TIT / BIV). Accepts JSON string or object. Rows matched by natural key are field-merged (changes win). New rows are appended. Omitted tables are left untouched.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate.description: Activate after patch. Default: false.

skip_validation.description: Skip client-side validation of the merged result. Default: false.

ReadTextElementsBulk.description: Read every text element (R/I/S/H) of a program in ONE call via the TPOOL RFC. Partitions rows by type and returns structured arrays. Use this instead of calling GetTextElement per row.

class_name.description: Behavior Implementation class name (e.g., ZBP_MY_ENTITY). Must exist in the system.

test_class_source.description: Updated local test class ABAP source code.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (required for transportable packages).

UpdateClass.name: UpdateClass

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

activate.description: Activate after update. Default: false.

UpdateClassMethod.name: UpdateClassMethod
UpdateClassMethod.description: Update a single method implementation (METHOD...ENDMETHOD block) of an existing ABAP class without sending the entire class source. Splices the replacement into the current class source, then locks, syntax-checks the full reconstructed class, updates, unlocks, and optionally activates — a broken method never lands.

method_name.description: Method name to replace (e.g. 'GET_DATA', or for interface method implementations 'ZIF_FOO~BAR').

source.description: Full replacement method block. Must start with "METHOD <name>." and end with "ENDMETHOD." (leading/trailing blank lines tolerated); the name must match method_name.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

activate.description: Activate after update. Default: false.

UpdateDataElement.name: UpdateDataElement
UpdateDataElement.description:
Update an existing ABAP data element in SAP system.

Workflow:
1. Gets domain info (if type_kind is 'domain') to extract dataType/length/decimals
2. Acquires lock on the data element
3. Updates data element with provided parameters (complete replacement)
4. Unlocks data element
5. Optionally activates data element (default: true)
6. Returns updated data element details

Supported type_kind values:
- domain: Based on ABAP domain (requires type_name = domain name)
- predefinedAbapType: Direct ABAP type (requires data_type, length, decimals)
- refToPredefinedAbapType: Reference to ABAP type (requires data_type, length, decimals)
- refToDictionaryType: Reference to another data element (requires type_name = data element name)
- refToClifType: Reference to class (requires type_name = class name)

Note: All provided parameters completely replace existing values. Field labels are truncated to max lengths (10/20/40/55).

data_element_name.description: Data element name to update (e.g., ZZ_TEST_DTEL_01)

description.description: New data element description

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

type_kind.description: Type kind: domain, predefinedAbapType, refToPredefinedAbapType, refToDictionaryType, refToClifType

type_name.description: Type name: domain name, data element name, or class name (depending on type_kind)

data_type.description: Data type (CHAR, NUMC, etc.) - for predefinedAbapType or refToPredefinedAbapType

activate.description: Activate data element after update (default: true)

UpdateDomain.name: UpdateDomain
UpdateDomain.description:
Update an existing ABAP domain in SAP system.

Workflow:
1. Acquires lock on the domain
2. Updates domain with provided parameters (complete replacement)
3. Performs syntax check
4. Unlocks domain
5. Optionally activates domain (default: true)
6. Returns updated domain details

Note: All provided parameters completely replace existing values. Use GetDomain first to see current values if needed.

description.description: New domain description (optional)

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

datatype.description: Data type: CHAR, NUMC, DATS, TIMS, DEC, INT1, INT2, INT4, INT8, CURR, QUAN, etc.

decimals.description: Decimal places (for DEC, CURR, QUAN types)

conversion_exit.description: Conversion exit routine name (without CONVERSION_EXIT_ prefix)

value_table.description: Value table name for foreign key relationship

UpdateFunctionGroup.name: UpdateFunctionGroup
UpdateFunctionGroup.description: Update metadata (description) of an existing ABAP function group. Function groups are containers for function modules and don't have source code to update directly. Uses stateful session with proper lock/unlock mechanism.

function_group_name.description: Function group name (e.g., ZTEST_FG_001). Must exist in the system.

description.description: New description for the function group.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Optional if object is local or already in transport.

UpdateFunctionModule.name: UpdateFunctionModule
UpdateFunctionModule.description: Update source code of an existing ABAP function module. Locks the function module, uploads new source code, and unlocks. Optionally activates after update. Use this to modify existing function modules without re-creating metadata. NOTE: the write persists (as the inactive version) even when the post-write syntax check fails, and those check errors can originate from pre-existing defects in sibling FMs of the same function group — re-read the FM before assuming your write was lost. For repairs spanning many FMs prefer the abapGit path.

function_group_name.description: Function group name containing the function module (e.g., ZOK_FG_MCP01).

function_module_name.description: Function module name (e.g., Z_TEST_FM_MCP01). Function module must already exist.

source_code.description:
Complete ABAP function module source code. Must include FUNCTION statement with parameters and ENDFUNCTION. Example:

FUNCTION Z_TEST_FM
  IMPORTING
    VALUE(iv_input) TYPE string
  EXPORTING
    VALUE(ev_output) TYPE string.
  
  ev_output = iv_input.
ENDFUNCTION.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable function modules. For local objects ($TMP package) this can be omitted — the handler defaults to "local".

activate.description: Activate function module after source update. Default: false. Set to true to activate immediately.

UpdateGuiStatus.name: UpdateGuiStatus
UpdateGuiStatus.description: ⚠️ FULL REPLACE — overwrites the entire GUI Status definition (all 12 CUA tables) for the program. Any row or field you omit is DROPPED. Always Read (ReadGuiStatus) → modify → Update, or use PatchGuiStatus for row-level merges. cua_data must include complete STA / FUN / PFK / BUT / TIT rows with all required fields (CODE, PFNO, FUNCODE, ...). Handles lock/unlock automatically.

cua_data.description: Complete CUA data — accepts either a JSON string or a structured object with ADM / STA / FUN / MEN / MTX / ACT / BUT / PFK / SET / DOC / TIT / BIV. Required row fields: STA.CODE, FUN.CODE, PFK.{CODE,PFNO,FUNCODE}, BUT.{PFK_CODE,CODE,NO,PFNO}, TIT.CODE. Missing rows are dropped — this is full-replace semantics.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate.description: Activate after update. Default: false.

skip_validation.description: Skip client-side schema validation. Default: false. Only set true if you know the CUA payload is intentionally partial and SAP will accept it.

UpdateInclude.name: UpdateInclude
UpdateInclude.description: Update source code of an existing ABAP Include program (Type I). Locks the include, uploads new source code, and unlocks. Optionally activates after update. Use this instead of UpdateProgram for Type I include programs.

include_name.description: Include program name. Must already exist as Type I include in SAP.

source_code.description: Complete ABAP include source code. Do NOT include a REPORT statement — include programs start directly with code or comments.

main_program.description: Name of the parent/master program that contains this include. When provided, a program-wide syntax check is run after the source is uploaded to catch ABAP errors in the new include code. Highly recommended.

transport_request.description: Transport request number. Required for transportable packages.

activate.description: Activate include after source update. Default: false. Set to true to activate immediately.

UpdateInterface.name: UpdateInterface
UpdateInterface.description: Update source code of an existing ABAP interface. Uses stateful session with proper lock/unlock mechanism. Lock handle and transport number are passed in URL parameters.

interface_name.description: Interface name (e.g., ZIF_MY_INTERFACE). Must exist in the system.

source_code.description: Complete ABAP interface source code with INTERFACE...ENDINTERFACE section.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Optional if object is local or already in transport.

activate.description: Activate interface after update. Default: true.

UpdateLocalDefinitions.name: UpdateLocalDefinitions
UpdateLocalDefinitions.description: Update local definitions in an ABAP class (definitions include). Manages lock, check, update, unlock, and optional activation.

definitions_code.description: Updated source code for local definitions.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate_on_update.description: Activate parent class after updating. Default: false

UpdateLocalMacros.name: UpdateLocalMacros
UpdateLocalMacros.description: Update local macros in an ABAP class (macros include). Manages lock, check, update, unlock, and optional activation. Note: Macros are supported in older ABAP versions but not in newer ones.

macros_code.description: Updated source code for local macros.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate_on_update.description: Activate parent class after updating. Default: false

UpdateLocalTestClass.name: UpdateLocalTestClass
UpdateLocalTestClass.description: Update a local test class in an ABAP class. Manages lock, check, update, unlock, and optional activation of parent class.

test_class_code.description: Updated source code for the local test class.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (required for transportable objects).

activate_on_update.description: Activate parent class after updating test class. Default: false

UpdateLocalTypes.name: UpdateLocalTypes
UpdateLocalTypes.description: Update local types in an ABAP class (implementations include). Manages lock, check, update, unlock, and optional activation.

local_types_code.description: Updated source code for local types.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate_on_update.description: Activate parent class after updating. Default: false

UpdateMetadataExtension.name: UpdateMetadataExtension
UpdateMetadataExtension.description: Update source code of an ABAP Metadata Extension (DDLX). Modifies Fiori UI annotations, field labels, search help, and list/object page layout for CDS views.

lock_handle.description: Lock handle from LockObject. If not provided, will attempt to lock internally.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (required for transportable packages).

activate.description: Activate after update. Default: true

UpdateProgram.name: UpdateProgram
UpdateProgram.description: Update source code of an existing ABAP program. Locks the program, checks new code, uploads new source code, and unlocks. Optionally activates after update. Use this to modify existing programs without re-creating metadata.

program_name.description: Program name (e.g., Z_TEST_PROGRAM_001). Program must already exist.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

activate.description: Activate program after source update. Default: false. Set to true to activate immediately, or use ActivateObject for batch activation.

UpdateScreen.name: UpdateScreen
UpdateScreen.description: Update an ABAP Screen (Dynpro) definition. Provide full screen data as JSON. Handles lock/unlock automatically.

dynpro_data.description: Complete screen definition as JSON (from GetScreen/ReadScreen).

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate.description: Activate after update. Default: false.

UpdateServiceBinding.name: UpdateServiceBinding
UpdateServiceBinding.description: Update publication state for ABAP service binding via AdtServiceBinding workflow.

service_type.description: OData service type for publish/unpublish action routing.

UpdateServiceDefinition.name: UpdateServiceDefinition
UpdateServiceDefinition.description: Update source code of an existing ABAP service definition. Uses stateful session with proper lock/unlock mechanism.

service_definition_name.description: Service definition name (e.g., ZSD_MY_SERVICE). Must exist in the system.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Optional if object is local or already in transport.

activate.description: Activate service definition after update. Default: true.

UpdateSourceByPatch.name: UpdateSourceByPatch
UpdateSourceByPatch.description: Modify existing ABAP source code on SAP via a surgical string replacement (find old_string, replace with new_string) instead of resending the full source. Fetches the current source, applies the patch, then delegates the write to the same lock -> syntax-check -> update -> unlock -> (activate) flow used by UpdateClass/UpdateProgram/UpdateInterface/UpdateInclude/UpdateFunctionModule. Supported object_type values: CLAS (class), PROG (program, on-premise/legacy only), INTF (interface), INCL (include, on-premise/legacy only), FUNC (function module, requires function_group). old_string must match the current source exactly, including whitespace, and must be unique unless replace_all is true.

object_type.description: ABAP object kind to patch: CLAS (class), PROG (program), INTF (interface), INCL (include), FUNC (function module).

object_name.description: Name of the object to patch (e.g., ZCL_MY_CLASS).

function_group.description: Function group name. Required when object_type is 'FUNC'.

old_string.description: Exact text to find in the current source (whitespace-sensitive). Must match exactly once unless replace_all is true.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_string instead of requiring a unique match. Default: false.

transport_request.description: Transport request number, passed through to the delegated update handler.

activate.description: Activate the object after the patched source is written. Default: false.

UpdateStructure.name: UpdateStructure
UpdateStructure.description: Update DDL source code of an existing ABAP structure. Locks the structure, uploads new DDL source, and unlocks. Optionally activates after update. Use this to modify existing structures without re-creating metadata.

structure_name.description: Structure name (e.g., ZZ_S_TEST_001). Structure must already exist.

ddl_code.description: Complete DDL source code for structure. Example: '@EndUserText.label : \'My Structure\' @AbapCatalog.tableCategory : #TRANSPARENT define structure zz_s_test_001 { client : abap.clnt not null; id : abap.char(10); name : abap.char(255); }'

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Optional if object is local or already in transport.

activate.description: Activate structure after source update. Default: true.

UpdateTable.name: UpdateTable
UpdateTable.description: Update DDL source code of an existing ABAP table. Locks the table, uploads new DDL source, and unlocks. Optionally activates after update. Use this to modify existing tables without re-creating metadata.

table_name.description: Table name (e.g., ZZ_TEST_TABLE_001). Table must already exist.

ddl_code.description: Complete DDL source code for a TRANSPARENT TABLE. IMPORTANT — use the MANDT data element for the client key ('key mandt : mandt not null'), NOT 'abap.clnt' (that's CDS-view syntax). Standard SAP tables (MARA, T001, VBAK, …) all use MANDT. The annotation block CreateTable seeded must be preserved verbatim: #NOT_EXTENSIBLE enhancement category, #TRANSPARENT tableCategory, #A deliveryClass, #RESTRICTED dataMaintenance. Example: '@EndUserText.label : \'My Table\' @AbapCatalog.enhancement.category : #NOT_EXTENSIBLE @AbapCatalog.tableCategory : #TRANSPARENT @AbapCatalog.deliveryClass : #A @AbapCatalog.dataMaintenance : #RESTRICTED define table ztst_table { key mandt : mandt not null; key id : abap.char(10); name : abap.char(255); }'

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Optional if object is local or already in transport.

activate.description: Activate table after source update. Default: true.

UpdateTextElement.name: UpdateTextElement
UpdateTextElement.description: Update an existing text element in an ABAP program text pool. Handles lock/unlock automatically.

key.description: Row key. Required except for "R" (single program title).

language.description: Language key. Defaults to SAP logon language.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate.description: Activate the parent program after write. Default: false.

UpdateUnitTest.description: Update an ABAP Unit test run. Note: ADT does not support updating unit test runs and will return an error.

UpdateView.name: UpdateView
UpdateView.description: Update DDL source code of an existing CDS View or Classic View. Locks the view, checks new code, uploads new DDL source, unlocks, and optionally activates.

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., E19K905635). Required for transportable packages.

activate.description: Activate after update. Default: false.

ValidateServiceBinding.name: ValidateServiceBinding
ValidateServiceBinding.description: Validate service binding parameters (name, service definition, package, version) via ADT validation endpoint.

description.description: Optional description used during validation.

package_name.description: ABAP package for the binding.

WriteTextElementsBulk.name: WriteTextElementsBulk
WriteTextElementsBulk.description: Register many ABAP text elements (R/I/S/H) in ONE tool call via a single TPOOL RFC write. Use instead of calling CreateTextElement N times. With activate=false (default) the pool is staged INACTIVE — the parent program's next activation promotes every entry atomically, which is the correct flow for "register 40 now, activate program later". With activate=true the pool is written ACTIVE immediately. Set replace_existing=false to merge into the current pool instead of replacing it.

language.description: 1-char language key (e.g. "K" for Korean). Defaults to SAP logon language.

text_elements.description: Array of entries. Each: { type: "R"|"I"|"S"|"H", key?: string, text: string }. R ignores key (single-row program title — key defaults to program name). I requires a 3-char key. S requires a parameter / select-option name (max 8 chars). H requires one of "listHeader" or "columnHeader_N".

replace_existing.description: If true (default), the TPOOL is replaced with the provided entries only. If false, existing rows are preserved and provided rows merge by (type, key).

transport_request.description: Transport request number (informational).

activate.description: false (default) — stage as INACTIVE (program activation promotes). true — write ACTIVE immediately.
